# Diwan POS

> Diwan POS is keyboard-first, offline-first point-of-sale software for retail shops, restaurants and pharmacies. It is sold as a one-time licence (no subscription) and runs on Windows, macOS, Linux and Android from a single licence key.

Key facts:

- Editions (prices in Pakistani Rupees): Starter Rs 8,000 (1 terminal), Standard Rs 12,000 (up to 3 terminals, 1 branch), Enterprise Rs 25,000 (unlimited terminals, multi-branch). All are one-time payments with free software updates.
- Free trial: 30 days on one device, no payment required, one trial per account. Start it from the customer dashboard after creating an account at https://diwan.codehunts.co.uk/auth/signup.html.
- Platforms: Windows 10+ (64-bit or 32-bit, .exe), macOS 11+ (separate Apple Silicon and Intel builds, .dmg), Linux x86_64 (.AppImage, .deb or .rpm) and Android 8.0+ (.apk). One licence key unlocks every platform.
- Works offline: an internet connection is needed once, for activation. Billing, stock tracking and printing continue without a connection, and sync resumes automatically.
- Delivery: the licence key and installer link are emailed within about a minute of confirmed payment and stay available in the customer dashboard. There is no physical product.
- Refunds: full refund within 14 days of purchase if the licence key has not been activated.
- Operator: Diwan is a sole proprietorship run by Hamza Waheed, I-10/2, Islamabad 44000, Pakistan. Support: hamzawaheed057@gmail.com, +92 314 3288112, Monday to Saturday 10:00am–7:00pm PKT.

## Product

- [Home](https://diwan.codehunts.co.uk/): overview of Diwan POS, how it works, platforms and pricing summary
- [Features](https://diwan.codehunts.co.uk/features.html): keyboard-first billing, inventory, reporting, offline sync, printer support and cross-platform licensing
- [Products & Editions](https://diwan.codehunts.co.uk/products.html): the three licence editions, the platform builds and the services included with every licence
- [Pricing](https://diwan.codehunts.co.uk/pricing.html): edition prices, what each includes, and pricing FAQ
- [Restaurant POS](https://diwan.codehunts.co.uk/restaurant-pos.html): per-table bills, one-key tokens, kitchen chits and Android order-taking for restaurants and cafés
- [Retail POS](https://diwan.codehunts.co.uk/retail-pos.html): keyboard checkout, stock decremented per sale, and support for older and low-cost PCs
- [Pharmacy POS](https://diwan.codehunts.co.uk/pharmacy-pos.html): quick billing, stock control and offline selling, with sales data kept on the store's own machine
